boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Adelphi University
boards.description: Verifiable late-night dining and snack destinations near the Garden City campus, including on-campus staples and local 24-hour favorites.

cards.title: The Eatery at Post Hall
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Late Night Grill
cards.notes: Visit the lower level of Post Hall for late-night grill favorites like burgers and chicken fingers, typically serving until midnight daily.
cards.short_summary: The primary on-campus destination for late-night hot meals and social gathering at Post Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Eatery at Post Hall offers late-night menus and is open for late-night ordering until 12:00 midnight.
cards.source_title: Spring 2021 Dining Update | Adelphi University
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM daily for late-night grill service.

cards.title: Panther Mart
cards.subtitle: Post Hall Convenience Store
cards.notes: Grab snacks, beverages, and convenience items at this Post Hall hub, which transitions to a late-night grill service after standard hours.
cards.short_summary: A central campus convenience store in Post Hall that provides late-night snacks and grill items.
cards.evidence_claim: The Panther Mart C-Store in Post Hall is open for late-night ordering until 12:00 midnight.
cards.source_title: Spring 2021 Dining Update | Adelphi University
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM daily; accepts Panther Dollars.

cards.title: Cherry Valley Deli
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Local Deli Staple
cards.notes: Head to this legendary 24-hour deli for signature sandwiches like the 'Coyote' or 'Bindie' just a short drive from campus.
cards.short_summary: A famous 24/7 deli in West Hempstead known for its extensive menu of unique, heavy sandwiches.
cards.evidence_claim: Cherry Valley West Hempstead is open 24/7 with fresh food, deli, and snacks every single day.
cards.source_title: Open 24 HOURS. Every single day At Cherry Valley West Hempstead
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

cards.title: IHOP Williston Park
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Breakfast Run
cards.notes: Drive north to Hillside Avenue for a full breakfast menu available at any hour, a classic choice for late-night study breaks.
cards.short_summary: A reliable 24-hour pancake house located a few miles north of the Adelphi campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The IHOP location at 145 Hillside Ave in Williston Park is open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: IHOP® Breakfast in Williston Park, NY on 145 Hillside Ave
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: 7-Eleven Franklin Square
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Convenience Stop
cards.notes: Stop by this 24-hour convenience store on Hempstead Turnpike for quick snacks, hot food, and beverages at any hour.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store located just south of campus on a major local thoroughfare.
cards.evidence_claim: The 7-Eleven at 850 Hempstead Turnpike in Franklin Square is open 24/7.
cards.source_title: 850 Hempstead Turnpike Franklin Square NY 11010-3632 - 7-Eleven
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Applebee's Westbury
cards.subtitle: Late Night Half-Price Apps
cards.notes: Visit this neighborhood grill for half-price appetizers starting at 9:00 PM, a popular late-night dining option for students.
cards.short_summary: A casual dining chain in Westbury known for its late-night appetizer specials and extended hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Applebee's Westbury is open until 12:00 AM and serves half-price appetizers from 9:00 PM to close.
cards.source_title: Applebee's Grill + Bar in Westbury, NY
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM daily; late-night specials begin at 9:00 PM.

cards.title: Dunkin' Nassau Blvd
cards.subtitle: Evening Coffee & Donuts
cards.notes: Grab a late-evening coffee or donut at this Nassau Boulevard location, situated conveniently near the campus perimeter.
cards.short_summary: A nearby coffee and donut shop that provides late-evening options for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dunkin' at 334 Nassau Blvd in Garden City is open until 9:00 PM daily.
cards.source_title: Dunkin' at 334 Nassau Blvd in Garden City
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM daily.

cards.title: Grand Lux Cafe
cards.subtitle: Late Night Mall Dining
cards.notes: Located at Roosevelt Field, this upscale-casual spot offers a massive menu with late-night hours on weekends.
cards.short_summary: An expansive restaurant at Roosevelt Field Mall offering late-night dining options near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Grand Lux Cafe at Roosevelt Field is open until 11:00 PM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: American Restaurant in Garden City, New York - Grand Lux Cafe
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM on Friday and Saturday; 10:00 PM on other nights.

cards.title: Halal Munchies
cards.subtitle: Late Night Halal Platters
cards.notes: Order chicken or lamb over rice platters at this Hempstead spot, a favorite for students seeking flavorful late-night meals.
cards.short_summary: A popular halal restaurant in Hempstead offering late-night platters and sandwiches.
cards.evidence_claim: Halal Munchies in Hempstead offers freshly prepared halal platters and is a known late-night food destination.
cards.source_title: Halal Munchies Hempstead NY
cards.access_notes: Open late daily; check mobile apps for current closing times.

cards.title: Late Night Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Finals Week Tradition
cards.notes: Join fellow students in Post Hall during finals week for a complimentary late-night breakfast served by university staff.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal university-hosted event providing free late-night meals to students during final exams.
cards.evidence_claim: Adelphi University hosts a Late Night Breakfast event in Post Hall from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM during finals.
cards.source_title: Late Night Breakfast - December 10, 2025 - Adelphi University
cards.access_notes: Seasonal event held during finals week; typically 9:00 PM – 11:00 PM.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional study hubs, quiet lounges, and specialized resource centers that Adelphi students use for daily productivity and community connection.

cards.title: Swirbul Library Collaboration Studios
cards.subtitle: Swirbul Library First Floor
cards.notes: Reserve these tech-equipped rooms for group projects. They feature whiteboards and screens for shared work, located right on the library's main floor.
cards.short_summary: Tech-ready group study rooms in Swirbul Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Collaboration Studios, located on the first floor of Swirbul Library, are designed for group study and should be reserved ahead of time.
cards.source_title: Buildings, Rooms and Spaces | Swirbul Library
cards.access_notes: Reservations required through the library's online system; valid student ID needed for check-in.

cards.title: Quiet Study in Aimee Ornstein Lounge
cards.subtitle: Swirbul Library Second Floor
cards.notes: Find a peaceful environment for deep focus in this dedicated quiet zone. It is ideal for students who need a distraction-free space for individual work.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet study lounge on the second floor of Swirbul Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Enjoy a peaceful study environment in the Aimee Ornstein Lounge, ideal for focused work, located on the second floor of Swirbul Library.
cards.source_title: Buildings, Rooms and Spaces | Swirbul Library
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; designated as a quiet zone.

cards.title: Active Learning at Step & Study
cards.subtitle: Swirbul Library Room 105
cards.notes: Combine fitness with finals by using these reservable treadmill desks. It is a unique way to stay active while reading or typing.
cards.short_summary: Treadmill desks for active studying in Swirbul Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Take advantage of our “Step & Study” treadmill desks in Room 105 of Swirbul Library, featuring two treadmills for reservable use.
cards.source_title: Swirbul “Step & Study” Space
cards.access_notes: Reservable through the library's space availability system.

cards.title: The University Center Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Ruth S. Harley University Center First Floor
cards.notes: Charge your devices at modern seating stations or use the computer wall. This central hub is perfect for commuters and group meetups.
cards.short_summary: A modern social and study hub in the renovated University Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The new Student Lounge has comfortable modern seating featuring outlets and a wall of computers to help you catch up on academics.
cards.source_title: Floor-by-Floor Info | University Center
cards.access_notes: Open during University Center hours; includes free locker rentals for commuters.

cards.title: Quiet Reflection at the Mindfulness Center
cards.subtitle: University Center Third Floor
cards.notes: Escape the campus bustle in this acoustically designed quiet environment. It features a canopy of twinkling lights for meditation and relaxation.
cards.short_summary: A quiet space for meditation and reflection in the University Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mindfulness Room features a canopy and wall of twinkling lights within an acoustically designed quiet environment for personal meditation.
cards.source_title: Floor-by-Floor Info | University Center
cards.access_notes: Open to all students, staff, and faculty for personal practice or scheduled classes.

cards.title: Social Hub at the Nexus Building
cards.subtitle: Nexus Building
cards.notes: Enjoy the bright, airy atmosphere of the Nexus lounges. Large glass windows and open floor plans make this a popular spot for social interaction.
cards.short_summary: Bright, modern lounge spaces throughout the Nexus Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The bright lounge areas throughout the building have made Nexus the students' latest social hub.
cards.source_title: Nexus Building - Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible during building hours; home to the College of Nursing.

cards.title: Community Comfort in Social Work
cards.subtitle: Social Work Building
cards.notes: Relax in a lounge designed with a calming atmosphere. It features comfortable sofas, dim lighting, and a tabletop Zen garden for stress relief.
cards.short_summary: A student-designed comfort lounge in the Social Work Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Lounge in the Social Work Building is a comfortable study area for students with snack and drink vending.
cards.source_title: New Student Lounge Goes Beyond Being Social
cards.access_notes: Open to students during building hours; located in the Social Work Building.

cards.title: The Delphian Newsroom
cards.subtitle: Earle Hall A, Rooms 005/007
cards.notes: Visit the home of Adelphi's award-winning student newspaper. It is a space for writers, photographers, and creators to collaborate on campus news.
cards.short_summary: The headquarters for Adelphi's student-run newspaper.
cards.evidence_claim: Meetings are held Tuesdays at 6:00 p.m. in Earle Hall rooms 005/007. Earle Hall A is home to The Delphian student newspaper.
cards.source_title: Earle Hall A and B - Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Located in the lower level of Earle Hall A; meetings are open to all students.

cards.title: Tech Support at Hagedorn Hall
cards.subtitle: Hagedorn Hall of Enterprise Lower Level
cards.notes: Get hands-on technical assistance for your devices. This lower-level hub is the go-to spot for resolving campus network and software issues.
cards.short_summary: The primary on-campus location for IT support and services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Office of Information Technology Help Desk is located in Hagedorn Hall of Enterprise Lower Level.
cards.source_title: Hagedorn Hall of Enterprise (HHE) - Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Open during regular business hours; walk-ins are welcome for tech support.

cards.title: Fitness and Recreation at Woodruff
cards.subtitle: Woodruff Hall
cards.notes: Utilize the 5,000-square-foot fitness center or the racquetball courts. It is a historic building that serves as a primary spot for student wellness.
cards.short_summary: A comprehensive fitness and recreation facility in historic Woodruff Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Woodruff Hall houses a 5,000 square foot fitness center along with a half court gym, locker rooms, and two racquetball courts.
cards.source_title: Woodruff Hall - Adelphi University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Open to students with a valid Adelphi ID; hours vary by semester.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Explore the best free social spaces and activities at Adelphi University, from art galleries and arboretum walks to student-only fitness and late-night study hubs.

cards.title: Walk the Accredited Arboretum
cards.subtitle: 75-acre Garden City campus
cards.notes: Explore over 100 species of trees and shrubs on this pesticide-free campus. Follow the self-guided walking tour to see historic azaleas and the iconic cherry tree rows.
cards.short_summary: A globally recognized Level I Arboretum offering 75 acres of diverse botanical collections and scenic walking paths.
cards.evidence_claim: Adelphi's 75-acre Garden City campus is a Level I Arboretum with more than 100 species of trees and shrubs, maintained with a 100 percent pesticide-free commitment.
cards.source_title: More Than Just “Green Space”—Our Campus Is Now a Living Landmark
cards.access_notes: Open to the public daily; guided tours are occasionally offered for free but require registration.

cards.title: Book a Collaboration Studio
cards.subtitle: First floor of Swirbul Library
cards.notes: Reserve a high-tech group study room for up to two hours. Use the dry-erase walls and flat-screen monitors to brainstorm projects with your classmates for free.
cards.short_summary: Modern group study spaces equipped with writable walls and technology for student collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Collaboration Studios on the first floor of Swirbul Library are for current Adelphi students only and can be reserved for up to 2 hours a day at no cost.
cards.source_title: Collaboration Studios | Swirbul Library
cards.access_notes: Restricted to current Adelphi students with valid ID; reservation required. Open until midnight in select areas.

cards.entity_name: Adele and Herbert J. Klapper Art Gallery
cards.title: View Contemporary Art
cards.subtitle: Ruth S. Harley University Center
cards.notes: Visit the second floor of the UC to see rotating exhibitions of professional and student work. The gallery is free and open to the public daily until 8:00 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A campus art gallery hosting diverse exhibitions ranging from student projects to professional narrative-focused works.
cards.evidence_claim: The Adele and Herbert J. Klapper Art Gallery in the University Center is free and open to the public from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: College Art Galleries in New York | Art Exhibitions at Adelphi University
cards.access_notes: Open to the public daily from 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.

cards.title: Work Out at the CRS
cards.subtitle: Main campus recreation hub
cards.notes: Access the 5,000-square-foot fitness center, indoor track, and three-court gym. Present your student ID for free entry to all recreational facilities.
cards.short_summary: A comprehensive fitness and sports facility available for free to the Adelphi student community.
cards.evidence_claim: Recreation facilities are open at no cost to current Adelphi students, faculty, administration, and staff with a valid ID.
cards.source_title: Campus Recreation | Adelphi University
cards.access_notes: Free for current students with valid ID; alumni and community members require a paid membership.

cards.title: Grab a Free Rush Ticket
cards.subtitle: One hour before showtime
cards.notes: Line up at the box office 60 minutes before a performance to claim a free student rush ticket. Available for most guest artist and departmental shows.
cards.short_summary: A program providing full-time students with free admission to world-class performances on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.evidence_claim: One hour before all performances, full-time Adelphi students are eligible to get a Rush ticket at no cost with their Adelphi ID.
cards.source_title: Student Discounts | Performing Arts Center
cards.access_notes: Available to full-time Adelphi students only; subject to seat availability 10-60 minutes before start.

cards.title: Hang Out in the Nexus Lounges
cards.subtitle: Modern social and study hub
cards.notes: Relax in the airy, open-floor lounges of this award-winning building. It's a popular spot for meeting friends or catching up on work between classes.
cards.short_summary: A high-tech, visually striking building featuring multiple bright lounge areas for student interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: The bright lounge areas throughout the Nexus Building have made it a social hub for students since it opened in 2016.
cards.source_title: Introducing Adelphi's Nexus Building
cards.access_notes: Open during standard building hours; accessible to all students.

cards.title: De-stress at the Mindfulness Center
cards.subtitle: Third floor of the University Center
cards.notes: Find a quiet moment to relax, meditate, or reflect in this dedicated wellness space. It is designed to offer a peaceful retreat from the busy campus life.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated campus space for meditation and reflection located in the heart of the University Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mindfulness Center on the third floor of the Ruth S. Harley University Center offers a space for students to relax, meditate, and reflect.
cards.source_title: University Center | Adelphi University
cards.access_notes: Open to the Adelphi community during University Center operating hours.

cards.title: Tour the Outdoor Sculptures
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide art installation
cards.notes: Walk the grounds to discover large-scale sculptures by alumni and guest artists. The biennial exhibition turns the entire campus into an open-air gallery.
cards.short_summary: A campus-wide exhibition program featuring curated outdoor sculptures integrated into the arboretum landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: Adelphi features a campus-wide sculpture garden with multiple venues for exhibitions that are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Art Studios and Facilities at Adelphi | College Art Spaces
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor spaces; best viewed during daylight hours.

cards.title: Walk While You Work
cards.subtitle: Swirbul Library Room 105
cards.notes: Reserve a treadmill desk to stay active while studying. This unique space allows students to walk at a slow pace while using a laptop or reading.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library room featuring treadmill desks for students to combine physical activity with academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Step & Study Space in Room 105 of Swirbul Library contains two treadmill desks that can be reserved for 1-hour slots at no cost.
cards.source_title: Swirbul “Step & Study” Space | Adelphi University
cards.access_notes: Restricted to Adelphi students; reservation required. Users must follow safety guidelines and wear appropriate footwear.

cards.title: Visit the Panther Pantry
cards.subtitle: Lower level of Earle Hall
cards.notes: Access free food, toiletries, and clothing items if you are in need. This student-run resource is confidential and open to all Adelphi community members.
cards.short_summary: A campus resource providing essential goods and clothing to students and staff facing insecurity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Panther Pantry provides a variety of food, toiletries, school supplies, and clothing items, all free of charge to students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: Panther Pantry | Food Insecurity - Adelphi University
cards.access_notes: Located in Earle Hall Room 003; walk-ins welcome during open hours or order online via eCampus.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: From high-tech collaboration studios to quiet treadmill desks, Adelphi University offers a variety of specialized environments for focused academic work across its Garden City campus.

cards.title: Collaboration Studios
cards.subtitle: Swirbul Library First Floor
cards.notes: Reserve these tech-equipped rooms for group work. Each studio features whiteboards and screen-sharing capabilities for up to two hours daily.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group study rooms with whiteboards and technology in Swirbul Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Students can reserve these studios ahead of time for up to 2 hours a day and they are equipped with whiteboards and technology.
cards.source_title: Buildings, Rooms and Spaces | Swirbul Library | Adelphi University
cards.access_notes: Available to current Adelphi students; reservation required via the library website.

cards.title: Step & Study Space
cards.subtitle: Swirbul Library Room 105
cards.notes: Combine fitness with finals at these reservable treadmill desks. The room is limited to two occupants to maintain a quiet, focused environment.
cards.short_summary: A unique library room featuring two reservable treadmill desks for active studying.
cards.evidence_claim: The Step & Study Space in Room 105 of Swirbul Library features two treadmill desks that can be reserved separately.
cards.source_title: Swirbul “Step & Study” Space | Adelphi University
cards.access_notes: Reservable for 1-hour slots; no food or loud music allowed in the room.

cards.title: Aimee Ornstein Lounge
cards.subtitle: Swirbul Library Quiet Zone
cards.notes: Head to this dedicated quiet zone for silent individual study. It offers a peaceful environment away from the high-traffic areas of the first floor.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet study lounge located within the Swirbul Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Aimee Ornstein Lounge is a quiet study space at the Swirbul Library ideal for focused work.
cards.source_title: Buildings, Rooms and Spaces | Swirbul Library | Adelphi University
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; intended for silent, individual study.

cards.title: Nexus Third Floor Tables
cards.subtitle: Nexus Building Level 3
cards.notes: Find these tables for a scenic view of campus while you work. Each station includes integrated charging ports for laptops and mobile devices.
cards.short_summary: Quiet study tables on the third floor of the Nexus Building with campus views.
cards.evidence_claim: The third-floor Nexus study tables have charging ports and offer a scenic view of the campus.
cards.source_title: The Two Best Spots to Study in on Campus - The Delphian
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; typically less crowded than the first-floor lounge.

cards.title: UC Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Ruth S. Harley University Center
cards.notes: Utilize the modern seating and built-in outlets in this renovated hub. A wall of computers is available for quick academic tasks between classes.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative study and social space in the renovated University Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Lounge in the UC features modern seating with outlets and a wall of computers for academic use.
cards.source_title: Floor-by-Floor Info | University Center at Adelphi University
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; includes lockers and charging stations.

cards.title: Swirbul Library Cubicles
cards.subtitle: Swirbul Library Second Floor
cards.notes: Tucked away from main foot traffic, these cubicles provide individual desks with charging ports for long, uninterrupted study sessions.
cards.short_summary: Individual study cubicles located on the quiet second floor of Swirbul Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The library cubicles on the second floor are far from main foot traffic and include charging ports for phones and laptops.
cards.source_title: The Two Best Spots to Study in on Campus - The Delphian
cards.access_notes: Available on a first-come, first-served basis during library hours.

cards.title: James Riley, Jr. Trading Room
cards.subtitle: Hagedorn Hall of Enterprise
cards.notes: Access professional-grade financial terminals in this specialized business lab. It is the primary hub for finance and accounting students.
cards.short_summary: A high-tech trading floor and study lab for business students in Hagedorn Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Hagedorn Hall houses the James Riley, Jr. Trading Room, a specialized facility for the School of Business.
cards.source_title: Hagedorn Hall of Enterprise (HHE) - Adelphi University Interactive Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Primarily for business students; check building schedule for open lab hours.

cards.title: Social Work Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Social Work Building
cards.notes: Visit this comfortable drop-in center for a relaxed study atmosphere. The lounge includes vending machines for quick snacks during study breaks.
cards.short_summary: A comfortable drop-in study area located in the Social Work Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Lounge in the Social Work Building is a comfortable study area for students with snack and drink vending.
cards.source_title: Student Lounge - Campus Map - Adelphi University
cards.access_notes: Open to all students during building hours.

cards.title: Woodruff Hall Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Woodruff Hall
cards.notes: Use the workstations in this historic building for academic projects. It serves as a convenient study spot near the campus fitness facilities.
cards.short_summary: A student computer lab located within the historic Woodruff Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Woodruff Hall includes a student computer lab along with its fitness and academic facilities.
cards.source_title: Woodruff Hall - Adelphi University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; requires Adelphi login for computer use.

cards.title: Manhattan Center Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: 529 Fifth Avenue, NYC
cards.notes: Study in the heart of Midtown at this satellite facility. The center offers private study spaces, a library, and a student lounge for commuters.
cards.short_summary: Modern study spaces and a library at Adelphi's Midtown Manhattan location.
cards.evidence_claim: The Manhattan Center includes a library, computer lab, private study spaces, and a student lounge.
cards.source_title: Manhattan Center Building Access - Adelphi University
cards.access_notes: Requires Adelphi ID for building entry; accessible via Grand Central Station.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the essential corridors and commercial blocks surrounding Adelphi University's Garden City campus, from local delis to historic village centers.

cards.title: The Classic Student Deli
cards.subtitle: Nassau Boulevard
cards.notes: Visit this long-standing local deli for signature breakfast sandwiches and catering favorites located just a few blocks west of the campus perimeter.
cards.short_summary: A staple delicatessen on Nassau Boulevard serving the Adelphi community for over 80 years.
cards.evidence_claim: Adelphi Delicatessen is located at 351 Nassau Blvd, Garden City, NY 11530 and has served the community for over 80 years.
cards.source_title: Adelphi Delicatessen | Garden City, NY
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 6:00 AM to 4:00 PM for walk-in orders and catering.

cards.title: The LIRR Connection
cards.subtitle: Nassau Boulevard
cards.notes: Catch the Hempstead Branch train at this station, which serves as a primary transit link for commuting students and faculty.
cards.short_summary: A key Long Island Rail Road station located on the western edge of the Garden City campus area.
cards.evidence_claim: Adelphi University is located near the Nassau Boulevard Station on the LIRR Hempstead line.
cards.source_title: Transportation Around Campus | Visitors Guide - Adelphi University
cards.access_notes: Public transit station accessible 24/7; train schedules vary by day.

cards.title: Garden City's Main Street
cards.subtitle: Seventh Street
cards.notes: Walk along this central village corridor to find a variety of upscale eateries, boutiques, and the local Garden City Public Library.
cards.short_summary: The primary commercial and social hub of Garden City, featuring diverse dining and shopping options.
cards.evidence_claim: Seventh Street is a key area of interest in Garden City, home to the Public Library and numerous restaurants like il Gufo and The Burger Spot.
cards.source_title: Key Areas of Interest | Garden City, NY
cards.access_notes: Public street with various business hours; generally active from morning through late evening.

cards.title: Gourmet Grocery Hub
cards.subtitle: Franklin Avenue
cards.notes: Shop for high-quality groceries and prepared foods at this market located at the intersection of Franklin Avenue and 9th Street.
cards.short_summary: A premium grocery store serving the Garden City area with fresh produce and gourmet deli selections.
cards.evidence_claim: Kings Food Markets is located at 870 Franklin Ave in Garden City, near the intersection with 9th Street.
cards.source_title: Grocery Store Near Me - Kings in Garden City, NY
cards.access_notes: Open daily; typically 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM.

cards.title: Historic Village Landmark
cards.subtitle: Stewart Avenue
cards.notes: View this iconic luxury hotel on Stewart Avenue, a cornerstone of the village's history since the late 19th century.
cards.short_summary: A world-class luxury hotel and historic landmark located in the heart of Garden City.
cards.evidence_claim: The Garden City Hotel is listed as a key area of interest and historic site on Stewart Avenue.
cards.source_title: Key Areas of Interest | Garden City, NY
cards.access_notes: Hotel grounds are accessible; interior dining and services require purchase.

cards.title: Gothic Revival Architecture
cards.subtitle: Cathedral Avenue
cards.notes: Admire the towering spire and stained glass of this 1876 cathedral, built in memory of village founder Alexander Turney Stewart.
cards.short_summary: An Episcopalian cathedral and architectural landmark set on a lush green oasis in Garden City.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cathedral of the Incarnation was built in 1876 and is a prominent landmark in Garden City.
cards.source_title: Village Markers | Garden City, NY
cards.access_notes: Grounds are open to the public; check official site for service and tour times.

cards.title: Western Gateway Transit
cards.subtitle: Stewart Avenue
cards.notes: Utilize this LIRR station located just west of the campus for additional commuting options on the Hempstead Branch.
cards.short_summary: One of the five railroad stations providing service to the Garden City and Adelphi area.
cards.evidence_claim: Stewart Manor is one of the five railroad stations providing service to Garden City on the Hempstead Line.
cards.source_title: Key Areas of Interest | Garden City, NY
cards.access_notes: Public transit station accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Community Resource Center
cards.subtitle: Seventh Street
cards.notes: Access extensive local archives and quiet study spaces at this public library located near the village's main commercial strip.
cards.short_summary: The central public library for Garden City, offering resources and historical information about the area.
cards.evidence_claim: The Garden City Public Library is located on Seventh Street and holds historical information about the village.
cards.source_title: Key Areas of Interest | Garden City, NY
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 9:30 AM to 9:00 PM, Friday-Saturday 9:30 AM to 5:00 PM, Sunday 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM.

cards.title: The Regional Transit Hub
cards.subtitle: Station Plaza
cards.notes: Connect to the Port Jefferson and Ronkonkoma LIRR lines or various NICE bus routes at this major hub served by the Panther Express.
cards.short_summary: A major transportation hub in Mineola that connects Adelphi students to the broader Long Island region.
cards.evidence_claim: Adelphi's Panther Express shuttle provides transportation to the Mineola Station on the Port Jefferson Line.
cards.source_title: Transportation Around Campus | Visitors Guide - Adelphi University
cards.access_notes: Public transit hub accessible 24/7; shuttle service hours vary by semester.

cards.title: Local Services Corridor
cards.subtitle: Cherry Valley Avenue
cards.notes: Find essential services and local businesses along this road that borders the southern and western reaches of the Garden City area.
cards.short_summary: A commercial corridor featuring local businesses and services near the Adelphi campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Cherry Valley Avenue is a major road in Garden City and home to businesses like Somerset Brewing Company (94C Cherry Valley Ave).
cards.source_title: Stewart Avenue (Nassau County, New York) - Wikipedia
cards.access_notes: Public street with various business hours.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique rituals and annual celebrations that define the Panther experience at Adelphi University, from academic ceremonies to spirited campus-wide festivals.

cards.title: Matriculation Ceremony
cards.subtitle: The Official Welcome to the Community of Scholars
cards.notes: Join the annual academic parade where faculty in full regalia welcome the incoming class to the University community at the Center for Recreation and Sports.
cards.short_summary: A time-honored academic ceremony marking the official entry of first-year and transfer students into the Adelphi community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Matriculation ceremony is a time-honored academic tradition in which first-year students become members of the Adelphi University community of scholars, joined by faculty in full academic regalia.
cards.source_title: Adelphi Traditions
cards.access_notes: Held annually during Orientation Weekend in August at the Center for Recreation and Sports.

cards.title: The Panther Statue Photo
cards.subtitle: A Rite of Passage for New Panthers
cards.notes: Snap a photo with the 8-foot bronze mascot outside the Center for Recreation and Sports to mark your official status as an Adelphi Panther.
cards.short_summary: A popular photo-op tradition for new students and graduates featuring the university's bronze panther mascot.
cards.evidence_claim: The Panther statue, located outside the Center for Recreation and Sports, is a popular photo-op spot for new students to mark becoming a Panther.
cards.source_title: Ten Things You Should Do as a First-Year Student at Adelphi
cards.access_notes: The statue is located outdoors and accessible 24/7 for photos.

cards.title: Panther Madness
cards.subtitle: The Kickoff to Basketball Season
cards.notes: Celebrate the start of the basketball season with Fan Fest, student dance performances, and the introduction of the men's and women's teams.
cards.short_summary: A revitalized campus tradition, formerly known as Midnight Madness, that celebrates Panther pride and the start of the basketball season.
cards.evidence_claim: Panther Madness, formerly known as Midnight Madness, is a community celebration featuring the introduction of the basketball programs and a pre-event Fan Fest.
cards.source_title: SAVE THE DATE: Panther Madness Set for November 7
cards.access_notes: Typically held in early November at the Center for Recreation and Sports.

cards.title: Spirit Spot Showdown
cards.subtitle: Painting the Campus Parking Spots
cards.notes: Compete to paint a campus parking spot with creative designs during Spirit Weekend for a chance to win a reserved space for the semester.
cards.short_summary: A creative Spirit Weekend tradition where students, faculty, and staff paint parking spots to show Panther pride.
cards.evidence_claim: The Spirit Spot Showdown is a Spirit Weekend tradition where participants paint a campus parking spot to compete for prizes, including a reserved parking space.
cards.source_title: An Event for the Ages: The Adelphi Community Comes Together for Spirit Weekend
cards.access_notes: Occurs annually during Spirit Weekend in October.

cards.title: Chalk Up!
cards.subtitle: Art on the Walkways
cards.notes: Grab some chalk and join students and faculty in transforming campus walkways into a vibrant gallery during the annual Fall Arts Festival.
cards.short_summary: A beloved activity during the Fall Arts Festival where the community uses chalk to draw images on Adelphi's walkways.
cards.evidence_claim: The beloved Chalk Up! activity involves students and faculty members using chalk to draw images on Adelphi's walkways during the Fall Arts Festival.
cards.source_title: Fall Arts Festival 2023: Healing With Arts for a Just Future
cards.access_notes: Held annually in October as part of the Fall Arts Festival.

cards.title: Late-Night Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Fueling Up for Finals
cards.notes: Take a break from studying for finals to enjoy a breakfast served by faculty and staff in the dining hall during finals week.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing tradition where faculty and staff serve breakfast to students late at night during the final exam period.
cards.evidence_claim: Late-Night Breakfast is listed as a favorite Adelphi tradition alongside other events like Midnight Madness.
cards.source_title: Adelphi Traditions
cards.access_notes: Typically held late at night during finals week in the University Center.

cards.title: Prestigious Panthers
cards.subtitle: A Gender-Neutral Homecoming Honor
cards.notes: Celebrate the naming of the Prestigious Panthers, a modern, gender-neutral alternative to the traditional homecoming king and queen.
cards.short_summary: A contemporary tradition at Adelphi that recognizes student leaders during Spirit Weekend with gender-neutral titles.
cards.evidence_claim: The naming of the Prestigious Panthers is the gender-neutral alternative to the traditional homecoming king and queen, established as a new tradition.
cards.source_title: Announcing the 2022 Prestigious Panthers and Spirit Court
cards.access_notes: Announced annually during Spirit Weekend in October.

cards.title: Senior Cap Decoration
cards.subtitle: Expressing Graduating Creativity
cards.notes: Personalize your graduation cap with unique designs and messages to showcase your personality and achievements during Commencement.
cards.short_summary: A tradition where graduating seniors decorate their mortarboards to express their unique identities at graduation.
cards.evidence_claim: Adelphi encourages graduates to decorate their caps to express their unique personalities and post photos to social media.
cards.source_title: Adelphi Traditions
cards.access_notes: Takes place leading up to the May Commencement ceremonies.

cards.title: Greek God & Goddess
cards.subtitle: The Highlight of Greek Week
cards.notes: Watch fraternity and sorority members compete in this spirited talent and personality competition during the annual Greek Week festivities.
cards.short_summary: A signature event of Greek Week where members of the Greek community compete for the titles of Greek God and Goddess.
cards.evidence_claim: The Greek God & Goddess event is a featured part of Greek Week at Adelphi University.
cards.source_title: Greek Week: Greek God & Goddess
cards.access_notes: Typically held in April during Greek Week in the University Center Ballroom.

cards.title: Pantherpalooza
cards.subtitle: The Welcome Weekend Festival
cards.notes: Kick off the academic year with live music, food, and activities during this high-energy festival held during Welcome Weekend.
cards.short_summary: A major student festival held during Welcome Weekend to celebrate the start of the fall semester.
cards.evidence_claim: During Welcome Weekend, Adelphi hosts the Pantherpalooza fest as part of the welcome-to-Adelphi experience.
cards.source_title: Adelphi Traditions
cards.access_notes: Held annually in late August during Welcome Weekend.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Adelphi University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A guide to the essential sequence of events and campus landmarks for new Panthers during their first weekend in Garden City.

cards.title: Unpack and Settle In
cards.subtitle: Move-In Day
cards.notes: Arrive at your assigned residence hall during your specific move-in time to meet your RA and start setting up your new home.
cards.short_summary: The official start of the residential experience for new students.
cards.evidence_claim: Move-In Day for resident students is scheduled for August 20, 2026, with specific times sent to student emails.
cards.source_title: New Student Orientation | Adelphi Accepted
cards.access_notes: Restricted to residential students with valid move-in appointments.

cards.title: Check In for Orientation
cards.subtitle: Orientation Weekend Kickoff
cards.notes: Head to the Flagpole Lawn at noon to officially check in for Orientation Weekend and receive your schedule of events.
cards.short_summary: The central gathering point for the start of orientation activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Check-in for Orientation at the Flagpole Lawn begins at 12:00pm on August 21, 2026.
cards.source_title: New Student Orientation | Adelphi Accepted
cards.access_notes: Open to all new first-year and transfer students.

cards.title: Visit One-Stop Student Services
cards.subtitle: Lower Level, Room 008
cards.notes: Stop by the lower level to handle any last-minute billing, financial aid, or registrar questions before classes begin.
cards.short_summary: The primary administrative hub for student financial and registration needs.
cards.evidence_claim: One-Stop Student Services in Levermore Hall Lower Level is open 9:00am–4:00pm during Orientation Weekend.
cards.source_title: One-Stop Student Services Center | Adelphi University
cards.access_notes: Open during business hours; appointments are recommended but walk-ins are accepted.

cards.title: Snap a Photo with the Panther
cards.subtitle: Center for Recreation and Sports
cards.notes: Visit the bronze Panther statue outside the CRS for a classic first-weekend photo-op to show off your school spirit.
cards.short_summary: A popular campus landmark and traditional photo spot for new students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Panther statue outside the Center for Recreation and Sports is a popular photo-op spot for first-year students.
cards.source_title: Ten Things You Should Do as a First-Year Student at Adelphi
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Explore the University Center
cards.subtitle: The UC
cards.notes: Check out the renovated hub for dining, the bookstore, and student lounges; it's the main social center of campus.
cards.short_summary: The central student union building featuring dining and community spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ruth S. Harley University Center (UC) serves as a hub for student life, dining, and the bookstore.
cards.source_title: University Center (UC) Hours of Operation
cards.access_notes: Open daily; weekend hours are typically 8:30 a.m.–10:00 p.m.

cards.title: Find a Study Spot in Nexus
cards.subtitle: Student Services Hub
cards.notes: Explore the bright, modern lounge areas and high-tech classrooms in this award-winning building.
cards.short_summary: A modern facility housing nursing labs and various student service offices.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nexus Building features bright lounge areas that serve as a social hub for students.
cards.source_title: Introducing Adelphi's Nexus Building
cards.access_notes: Open to students during building hours; houses Academic Services in room 145.

cards.title: Tour the Swirbul Library
cards.subtitle: Architectural Landmark
cards.notes: Visit this Richard Neutra-designed library to find your favorite quiet study nook or check out the gallery.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library and a significant example of modernist architecture.
cards.evidence_claim: Swirbul Library is an architectural gem designed by Richard Neutra, offering study spaces and galleries.
cards.source_title: Using the Libraries - Adelphi University
cards.access_notes: Adelphi ID required for certain services; check website for current weekend hours.

cards.title: Attend Matriculation
cards.subtitle: Official Welcome
cards.notes: Join your class for this formal ceremony where you are officially inducted into the Adelphi community of scholars.
cards.short_summary: A time-honored academic tradition welcoming the new incoming class.
cards.evidence_claim: Matriculation is a tradition where first-year students officially become members of the Adelphi community.
cards.source_title: Adelphi Traditions
cards.access_notes: Required for all new first-year students.

cards.title: Celebrate at Pantherpalooza
cards.subtitle: Welcome Weekend Festival
cards.notes: Enjoy live music, food, and games during this festive afternoon following the Matriculation ceremony.
cards.short_summary: A high-energy campus festival held during the first weekend of the fall semester.
cards.evidence_claim: Pantherpalooza is a Welcome Weekend fest featuring spirit, fun, and food activities for new students.
cards.source_title: Adelphi Traditions
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; typically held on campus lawns.

cards.title: Grab a Rush Ticket at the PAC
cards.subtitle: Student Performance Access
cards.notes: Check the box office for free rush tickets available to students one hour before many campus performances.
cards.short_summary: The venue for theatre, music, and dance performances on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Full-time Adelphi students are eligible for no-cost Rush tickets one hour before performances at the PAC.
cards.source_title: Student Discounts | Performing Arts Center
cards.access_notes: Requires valid Adelphi ID; subject to availability.
